'''Electro-goggles''' were similar in nature to [[Electrobinoculars/Legends|electrobinoculars]].

The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] used electro-goggles which aided in magnification and rangefinding when targeting,<ref name="off">{{FactFile|104|WES 5-6|Zam Wesell's Weapons}}</ref> such as while hunting [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. She also used them to see [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] hanging on to [[ASN-121/Legends|the droid]] that was used to release [[Kouhun/Legends|the creatures]] that were meant to kill the senator. Information was displayed on the viewfinder in an [[Unidentified script (Star Wars '76)|unknown script]].

==Behind the scenes==
The electro-goggles were created by the prop department for [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].
